vinfo.title: Inter Miami CF Stadium
vinfo.blurb: Inter Miami CF Stadium is a soccer-specific stadium in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States. Built on the site of the former Lockhart Stadium, the 21,550-seat stadium is the home pitch of MLS Next Pro side Inter Miami CF II.

vinfo.title: SoFi Stadium
vinfo.blurb: SoFi Stadium is a multi-purpose indoor stadium in Inglewood, California, United States, a suburb of Los Angeles. SoFi occupies the former site of the Hollywood Park Racetrack and neighbors the Kia Forum and Intuit Dome.
